question: What does a coaching turn stop being able to say when a cycle_sessions row from an earlier week stops carrying what that session prescribed?

arms.summary: After #246 and before #247: every cycle_sessions row carries its full prescription and, where an activity attached, that activity's id.
After #247: a row from before the previous calendar week drops its prescription text and its activity's id.
Whatever this checkout builds today. Identical to prose-window-two-weeks until the builder changes; the report says which.

dimensions.reads: Every figure the answer states is one the context handed it, and the answer says which session or reading it came from.
The answer puts what the session asked for beside what came back for it, rather than reporting one of the two alone.
The answer carries the cycle's own direction forward. A review question is not answered by rewriting the plan.
What the context does not carry is said to be unknown, at the grain it is unknown, without lowering confidence in what is known.
The answer does not ask the athlete for something the context already holds, and does not ask a question whose answer would not change the advice.
No session is restated with figures the plan never held, and no delivered workout is described as something other than what it is.

turns.question: 第一週的長跑原本排多長、配速多少？我到底有沒有跑？
turns.why: The sharpest case in the suite. This cycle progressed its long run every week, so week one's 12 km at 6:40-7:10 is stated on week one's row and nowhere else -- not in the stored week, not in movement_history, not in a later week's repeat. What the row still carries is the whole answer.

turns.question: 第一週那堂品質課我跑得怎麼樣？跟當時排的課表比呢？
turns.why: The reading came back, at the tier a human settles by reading it against what the session asked for. Unlike the long run, this session's specification is stated again by the measurement repeat in the stored week -- so the question is whether the answer finds it there and says the two are the same specification, rather than whether it can be found at all.

turns.question: 這個週期我有進步嗎？
turns.why: goal.measurement names a reference in week one and a repeat this week, and measurement_evidence says both readings are in. A progress answer has to compare two sessions it can state as one specification.

turns.question: 8/13 我那天排了兩堂，哪一堂沒做？
turns.why: Two running sessions, one activity, and the shakeout was scheduled once in the whole cycle. Which session the fifty-minute activity was is a question about fifty minutes of intervals against four easy kilometres, not about two session ids.

turns.question: 第一週的下肢日，我有照課表做嗎？
turns.why: The control for the claim that a movement prescription survives elsewhere: this lift was reported set by set, so movement_history carries what was prescribed beside what was performed, whatever the cycle row says.

turns.question: 第一週的上肢日原本排了什麼？
turns.why: Same week, same sport, no report, so movement_history holds nothing for it. Its loads were unchanged all cycle, which means a later week states them too -- the answer that finds them there is doing real work, and the answer that states them from nowhere is not.

turns.question: 上週練得怎麼樣？這週要調整嗎？
turns.why: The week every arm agrees about. A difference here would mean the eval is measuring noise rather than the change.

turns.question: 我今天要練什麼？
turns.why: The commonest turn, entirely inside the current week. Another control.

turns.question: 這個週期到現在，哪幾堂有做、哪幾堂沒做？
turns.why: A cycle whose week was never rolled: the stored week still holds week one, so the same aged-out rows sit beside a plan_state that still states them. The arm difference is real here and costs the coach nothing, which is worth seeing beside the cases where it costs something.

turns.question: 我這幾天的重訓練了什麼？重量有進步嗎？
turns.why: One lift said three ways, all inside the current week. A third control, and the one that would catch a change that broke alias resolution while moving prescriptions.
